text:
Aisha Khan: Quick note  PMs and managers: we added a short 'manager guidance' appendix to the OKR + self-review template about coaching tone and calibration checkpoints. Please skim. Link: https://redwood.docs.internal/people/okr-selfreview-v1#manager-guidance
Roberto Diaz: Saw it. Does it include examples for differentiating between "meets" and "exceeds" expectations?
Aisha Khan: Yep. Two example snippets: (1) Meets: 'Delivered feature X on schedule; outcomes matched success criteria (10% usage uplift).' (2) Exceeds: 'Delivered feature X two sprints early, shipped an experimentation framework, and adoption grew 25% vs baseline.'
Lina Chen: For self reviews, will employees be able to attach PRs and dashboards?
Aisha Khan: Yes  we added fields for 'evidence links' and encourage linking PRs, runbook commits, dashboards, and customer feedback.
"HR-bot": Reminder: Performance cycle opens 2026-04-01. Submit self-reviews by 2026-04-17 23:59 UTC.
Samir Patel: One request: include a short checklist for managers to run 1:1 calibration prep with direct reports.
Aisha Khan: Adding that now. Will ping again when doc is updated. Thanks!
